record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Random Matrix Theory and the Theory of Integrable Systems. II
record.original_question: For the focusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation on the half-line x≥0 with prescribed initial data u(x,0)=f(x) and boundary forcing u(0,t)=e^{iwt}, can one compute the long-time asymptotic behavior of the solution u(x,t) as t→∞ for fixed real w?

evidence.quote: A particular stand out open problem is to compute the long-time behavior of the solution u(x, t) of the focusing NLS equation, iut = uxx + 2|u|2u, with u(x, 0) = f(x), x ≥ 0, given and u(0, t) = eiwt, t ≥ 0 with w ∈ R.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the focusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation on the half-line,
    i u_t = u_{xx} + 2|u|^2 u,   x ≥ 0,  t ≥ 0,
with prescribed initial data u(x,0) = f(x) for x ≥ 0 (sufficiently smooth and decaying as x → ∞) and time-periodic Dirichlet boundary forcing
    u(0,t) = e^{iωt},   t ≥ 0,
where ω ∈ ℝ is a fixed real parameter. Determine, for each fixed ω ∈ ℝ, the leading-order long-time asymptotic behavior of the solution u(x,t) as t → ∞, in all relevant space-time regions (e.g., along rays x/t = const).
artifact.status_search_result: Boutet de Monvel, Its, and Kotlyarov (Comm. Math. Phys. 2009) derived long-time asymptotics for the focusing NLS on the half-line with periodic boundary condition of the form ae^{iα}e^{2iωt} under the assumption of vanishing initial data (and related compatibility/sufficient conditions). The general problem with arbitrary prescribed initial data f(x) and boundary forcing e^{iωt} (including instability issues of the Dirichlet-to-Neumann map noted in subsequent work) is not fully resolved; thus the problem is partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Long-Time Asymptotics for the Focusing NLS Equation with Time-Periodic Boundary Condition on the Half-Line
status_evidence.snippet: Considers focusing NLS on the quarter plane with vanishing initial data and time-periodic boundary data ae^{iα}e^{2iωt}, deriving long-time asymptotics via Riemann–Hilbert analysis.
status_evidence.claim: Long-time asymptotics established for the focusing NLS on the half-line with time-periodic boundary data, under vanishing initial data.

status_evidence.title: The Focusing NLS Equation on the Half-Line with Periodic Boundary Conditions: Instability of the Dirichlet to Neumann Map
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses instabilities of the Dirichlet-to-Neumann map for the focusing NLS on the half-line with periodic boundary conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Subtleties (instability of Dirichlet-to-Neumann map) remain for the periodic-boundary half-line problem, indicating the general problem is not completely resolved.
